raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "localTimeToUtc now resolves the offset at the actual wall-clock instant by validating candidate offsets from either side of a transition. I traced Berlin 2027-03-28 and 2027-10-31 at 10:00 and got the correct UTC instants (08:00Z and 09:00Z). Ambiguous and nonexistent local times are also handled sensibly, and the admin day-end bound is fixed too. I could not see slotsForDay itself, so I assumed it derives its slots from localTimeToUtc."}
